mainTopic: Why vessels may not be immersed one inside another for קדשים: רבי אילא's answer of חציצה, and why the משנה needs both its רישא and its סיפא
overview: This amud finishes the משנה's list of extra stringencies for קודש compared with תרומה. An אונן and a מחוסר כפורים must immerse before eating קודש, but not before eating תרומה. The גמרא then goes back to an earlier clause of the משנה. That clause says you may immerse vessels inside other vessels for תרומה but not for קודש, and the גמרא asks why. רבי אילא answers that the weight of the inner vessel blocks the water, which is a חציצה. The גמרא objects that the סיפא of the משנה, about untying knots before טבילה, already deals with חציצה, so the רישא should be about something else. The answer is that both clauses are about חציצה and each one is needed. From the רישא alone we would think only a heavy vessel counts as a חציצה. The amud ends partway through explaining why the סיפא alone would not have been enough, and that explanation continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Mourner and one lacking atonement must immerse for sacred food
steps.stepSummary: The משנה rules that an אונן and a מחוסר כפורים must immerse before eating קודש, but not before eating תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: An אונן and a person who still has to bring an atonement offering both need to immerse before eating sacred food, but not before eating תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the last line of the משנה's list of ways קודש is treated more strictly than תרומה. Two kinds of people need טבילה before eating קודש but not before eating תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An אונן has lost a close relative that day but did not touch the dead body. A מחוסר כפורים, such as a זב or a woman after childbirth, has already finished his own טבילה and still has to bring an offering. Neither one is in an ordinary state of טומאה, but for קודש the חכמים still require טבילה as an added stringency. For תרומה they do not.

keyTerms.meaning: A mourner on the day a close relative died
Someone who still has to bring an offering to finish becoming טהור
The portion of produce given to a כהן

phrases.english: An acute mourner and one lacking atonement
require immersion for sacred food,
but not for teruma.

steps.triggerLanguage: הָאוֹנֵן וּמְחוּסַּר כִּפּוּרִים צְרִיכִין טְבִילָה לַקֹּדֶשׁ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Last item in the משנה's list of stringencies for קודש over תרומה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An אונן and a מחוסר כפורים need טבילה for קודש but not for תרומה.

steps.title: Why may vessels not be immersed inside each other for sacred food
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא begins and asks why the משנה forbids immersing vessels one inside another for קודש.
steps.simpleTranslation: With sacred food, why is it not allowed?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens by going back to an earlier rule in the משנה and asking for its reason. This question sets up רבי אילא's answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier the משנה said that for תרומה you may immerse vessels inside other vessels, but for קודש you may not. The גמרא wants to know what problem the חכמים had in mind for קודש.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion that explains the משנה

steps.confusionAlert: This question is not about the אונן line just before it. It points back to the earlier clause of the משנה about immersing vessels inside vessels.

phrases.english: Gemara
With regard to sacred food, what is the reason one may not?
phrases.notes: He means the earlier rule in the משנה: vessels may be immersed inside vessels for תרומה, but not for קודש.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא by returning to an earlier clause of the משנה
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The reason the משנה forbids immersing vessels inside vessels for קודש

steps.title: The weight of the inner vessel blocks the water
steps.stepSummary: רבי אילא explains that the weight of the inner vessel creates a חציצה between the water and the vessels.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אילא said: because the weight of the vessel acts as a barrier.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אילא gives the reason: the inner vessel presses down on the outer one, so the water may not reach the spot where they touch.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For טבילה to work, the water must touch every part of the item. Where the heavy inner vessel rests on the outer vessel, the water may be blocked, and that counts as a חציצה. For קודש the חכמים were strict about this.

keyTerms.meaning: The אמורא who gives this answer

steps.whyThisMatters: This sets the theme of the rest of the sugya: is the רישא of the משנה really about חציצה?

phrases.english: Rabbi Ila said:
Because the weight of the vessel interposes.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי אִילָא מִפְּנֵי שֶׁכְּבֵידוֹ שֶׁל כְּלִי חוֹצֵץ
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The inner vessel's weight blocks the water at the point where the vessels touch, which is a חציצה.

steps.title: The latter clause already covers interposition
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא objects that the סיפא of the משנה is about חציצה, so the רישא should be about something else.
steps.simpleTranslation: But since the latter clause is about חציצה, the first clause must not be about חציצה. The latter clause teaches: the standard for תרומה is not like the standard for קודש. For קודש, a person unties a knotted item, dries it, immerses it, and only then ties it again. For תרומה, he may tie it and then immerse it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי אילא. It brings proof from the סיפא of the משנה that the חכמים dealt with חציצה separately.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The סיפא about untying knots before טבילה is clearly about חציצה. If the רישא were also about חציצה, the משנה would be repeating itself. So the רישא must have a different reason, and רבי אילא's explanation looks wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: The first clause of the משנה
The latter clause of the משנה
Something blocking the water during טבילה

phrases.english: But since the latter clause is because of interposition,
the first clause is not because of interposition!
For the latter clause teaches:
The standard of teruma is not like the standard of sacred food,
for with sacred food he unties and dries,
phrases.notes: This is about a garment or item tied in a knot; the knot itself could block the water.

phrases.english: and immerses, and afterward ties,
but with teruma he ties and afterward immerses!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָא מִדְּסֵיפָא מִשּׁוּם חֲצִיצָה רֵישָׁא לָאו מִשּׁוּם חֲצִיצָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבי אילא's answer in step 3
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אילא's claim that the רישא is about חציצה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The סיפא explicitly deals with חציצה. The משנה would not teach the same idea twice, so the רישא must be about a different concern.

steps.title: Both clauses are about interposition, and each is needed
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that both clauses are about חציצה, and explains why the רישא alone would not have been enough.
steps.simpleTranslation: Both the first and the latter clause are about חציצה, and both are needed. If the משנה had taught only the first clause, I would have thought the reason קודש is forbidden is the weight of the vessel, which is present there. But in the latter clause there is no heavy vessel, so I would have said that even for קודש it is not a חציצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא defends רבי אילא. It says the משנה needed to teach both clauses, and starts by showing what we would get wrong if we had only the רישא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The heavy vessel is a strong kind of blockage. From the רישא alone, we might think only a strong blockage like that counts for קודש. The סיפא teaches that even a plain knot, with no heavy weight, counts as a חציצה for קודש.

keyTerms.meaning: And it is necessary to teach both

phrases.english: The first clause and the latter clause are both because of interposition,
and it is necessary to teach both:
For had it taught us only the first clause,

phrases.aramaic: הֲוָה אָמֵינָא הַיְינוּ טַעְמָא דִּלְקֹדֶשׁ לָא —
phrases.english: I would have said this is the reason it is not allowed for sacred food —
because there is the weight of the vessel,

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל סֵיפָא, דְּלֵיכָּא כְּבֵידוֹ שֶׁל כְּלִי —
phrases.english: but in the latter clause, where there is no weight of a vessel —

phrases.aramaic: אֵימָא לְקֹדֶשׁ נָמֵי לָא הָוֵי חֲצִיצָה.
phrases.english: I would say that even for sacred food it is not an interposition.

steps.terutzHavaAmina: From the רישא alone, only a heavy vessel would count as a חציצה for קודש.
steps.terutzMaskana: The סיפא teaches that even a knot without any weight is a חציצה for קודש.

steps.title: Why the latter clause alone would not be enough
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא begins the second half of the צריכותא: what we would wrongly think if the משנה had taught only the סיפא.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if the משנה had taught only the latter clause, I would have said the reason it is not allowed for קודש is because...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now turns to the other side and starts to show why the סיפא alone would not have been enough. The sentence continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now the גמרא will show that the knot case has some special feature of its own. Because of that feature, we could not have learned the rule about vessels inside vessels from it. The specific reason comes on the next amud.

phrases.english: And had it taught us only the latter clause,
I would have said:
this is the reason it is not allowed for sacred food, because

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second half of the צריכותא begun in step 5
steps.terutzHavaAmina: From the סיפא alone, we might think the strictness for קודש comes from something special about knots.
